plan.title: Asset PR to Split Auction Award and PO

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title.
Invite the two vendors named in the case.
Commit the requested Start now, 30-minute schedule.
Publish the auction event.
Assert that publication reached a real project page.
Submit Vendor A's initial bid.
Assert that Vendor A's initial bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor A's revised bid.
Assert that Vendor A's revised bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's bid.
Assert that Vendor B's bid was accepted.
Close the auction before ranking and awarding.
Open the comparison grid containing both bidding vendors.
Assert that the lowest bid ranks first, making Vendor A rank 1 at 85.
Enter the awarding flow after the auction has closed.
Assert that the split-award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for the split asset award.

steps.note: Approve the submitted award with the required remark.
Complete the approved award and create the purchase orders.
Assert that the resulting POs contain the two awarded vendor line entries.
Return to the events list to verify the final event location.
Open the History tab after the event has ended and been awarded.
Assert that this plan's event appears in History.
